content: शकटः, -टम् [शक्-अटन् <ls>Uṇ. 4. 81</ls>] .²1 A cart, carriage, waggon; रोहिणीशकटम् <ls>Pt. 1. 213</ls>, <ls n="Pt. 1.">211</ls>, <ls n="Pt. 1.">212</ls>; <ls>Y. 3. 42</ls>. .²2 Cart-stand; caravansary; कृष्णरामौ वृतौ गोपैः पुराच्छकटमीयतुः <ls>Bhāg. 10. 42. 23</ls>. .{@-टः@} .²1 A form of military array resembling a wedge; <ls>Ms. 7. 187</ls>. .²2 A measure of capacity, cart-load equal to 2000 {%palas%}. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a demon slain by Kṛṣṇa when quite a boy. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of a tree (तिनिश). .²5 An implement for preparing grain.
